reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for COVID-19 related services when appropriately reported. 
Appropriate reporting includes 
• 
Vaccine administration provided inside the patients’ home is the only vaccine 
administration reported on the specific date of service 
• 
Unauthorized COVID-19 vaccines and/ or vaccine administration codes are not reported 
• 
Reporting a pediatric vaccine administration code for patients between 5 through 11 years 
of age 
• 
A maximum unit of one per day is reported for nucleic-acid based SARS-CoV-2 viral tests 
by any provider 
• 
The 59 modifier is appended to additional nucleic-acid based SARS-CoV-2 viral tests by 
any provider on the same date of service to indicate a testing for a separate sample from 
the same patient 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
Vaccine administration provided inside the patients’ home is reported on the same date of 
service as any other vaccine administration code 
• 
Unauthorized COVID-19 vaccines and/ or vaccine administration codes are reported 
• 
Pediatric vaccine administration codes are reported for patients younger than 5 years of 
age or 12 years of age and older 
• 
2 or more units per date of service is reported for nucleic-acid based SARS-CoV-2 viral 
tests by any provider without appending the 59 modifier to additional units 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT, HCPCS code(s), 
ICD-10-CM codes and modifiers reported.
